technology_name: AN ADVANCED SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR DIAGNOSING MENTAL HEALTH CONDITIONS USING ELECTROENCEPHALOGRAM SIGNAL ANALYSIS
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Standard clinical psychiatric profiling matches subjective patient symptom checks manually, causing high rates of early misdiagnosis windows for severe chronic disorders.
description: An advanced medical diagnostic assembly featuring an electroencephalogram (EEG) signal acquisition module, an analytical processing script core, a separate validation module, and a data visualization dashboard to detect schizophrenia and major depressive disorder trends.
applications: Clinical psychiatric diagnosis suites, mental health screening clinics, neuro-rehabilitation tracking centers, and digital health diagnostic platforms.
